title: Tavern 0.6.204: ignore passable blocks before a High Heels lift
public_notes_inline: High Heels now requires a native block ray hit that excludes passable blocks and liquids before requesting its collision-checked one-block lift. The source callback regression uses the normal White Lady effect: a flower previously requested a lift; flower/water no longer do, while solid-obstacle clearance still delegates to native tryTeleport. This is source validation, not native Player movement or full Java step-height parity. Runtime/paired0.6.204 is new; no BDS or LIVE deployment was performed in this source-first change.
